## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `ImportAProjectToWso2Cloud`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `import-project`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **ImportAProjectToWso2Cloud**.

## Step 2: Connect your Git provider

1. <!-- manual: Sign in to [WSO2 Cloud](https://console.devant.dev). -->
2. <!-- manual: Navigate to the organization overview page by clicking on the organization name at the top. The organization overview lists all your projects. -->
3. Select **Import** to import an existing WSO2 Integrator project.
4. <!-- manual: Select your Git provider and complete the authorization flow in the browser, then return to WSO2 Cloud. :::warning One-click OAuth2 authorization is only available for GitHub. To use Bitbucket, GitLab, or Azure DevOps, you must first add your credentials at the organization level. See [Connect a Git repository](../../manage/cloud/cicd/connect-git-repository.md) for instructions. ::: -->

## Step 3: Configure and import the project

1. <!-- manual: Select the organization that owns the repository. -->
2. <!-- manual: Select the repository and the branch. -->
3. <!-- manual: Set the path to the folder where your project lives within the repository. -->
4. <!-- manual: Optionally, give the project a name. -->
5. <!-- manual: Add the integrations you want to import. For each integration, click + next to each integration to add it individually, or click + next to the project name to add all integrations in the project at once. -->
6. <!-- manual: For each integration, set the integration name, an optional description, and the integration type. -->
7. Select **Save** for each integration once configured.
8. After configuring all integrations, click **Import**.
